title: Business Intelligence Analyst
text: Business Intelligence Analyst at Morgan McKinley (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: $600 - $800 p.d. + Super). This leading Sydney University is seeking a Business Intelligent Analyst who will deliver strategic advice, insights and guidance through the analysis of internal and external data and contextual information. This role supports the Director, Strategic Planning; Director, Strategic Ventures and other members of the Strategy Portfolio Leadership Team to provide high quality evidence-based strategic insights. The Strategy Analyst will partner with key stakeholders across portfolios, faculties and other communities to deliver major strategic initiatives of the University. Key Accountabilities: Data analysis and visualisation Support strategic initiative or regular strategic planning Support the design and development of strategic initiative and objectives that form part of Strategy and related projects. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline Excellent data analysis skills utilising relational and multidimensional raw datasets or databases with ability to merge multiple datasets to identify trends or segments along relevant demographic and/or financial dimensions Experience in scenario modelling and forecasting Excelled interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills Demonstrated ability to contextualise, interpret and integrate complex information and provide strategic direction and insight Experience managing multiple work streams Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills Effective management of a diverse group of key stakeholders Desirable: Pervious exposure to higher education/tertiary sector or a complex multi-faceted organisation If you are interested in this, or other opportunities with NSW Government call Aoife Power today on 02 8986 3115 or apply today. Morgan McKinley is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
